note: Menu Link Weight replaces the numeric menu-link 'weight' dropdown on the node edit form (and menu-link UI) with a drag-and-drop tabledrag widget; it hides core's weight select and injects a tabledrag table of siblings, recomputing weights across -50..50 on submit. Depends on menu_ui + node. Uses the core permission 'administer site configuration' (defines none of its own). Its only config is menu_link_weight.settings:menu_parent_form_selector, either 'default' or 'cshs'; the configure form is at /admin/config/user-interface/menu-link-weight (route menu_link_weight.settings). When set to 'cshs' AND the cshs module is installed, MenuLinkWeightServiceProvider swaps core's menu.parent_form_selector for CshsMenuParentFormSelector; a ConfigSubscriber invalidates the container when the setting changes. cshs is NOT installed on this site, so setting 'cshs' is safe (no service swap). Medium cases read back the configured selector; hard cases set the selector value, verified against menu_link_weight.settings.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal 'Menu Link Weight' module change about the menu settings on the node edit form?
evals.expected_output: It hides core's numeric menu-link 'weight' dropdown and replaces it with a drag-and-drop tabledrag widget listing the parent's siblings, so editors order the item by dragging; the drag order is converted back into real menu-link weights on submit.

evals.prompt: What is the only configuration setting Menu Link Weight provides, and what are its possible values?
evals.expected_output: menu_link_weight.settings:menu_parent_form_selector, which is either 'default' (core parent selector) or 'cshs' (Client-side hierarchical select, only effective if the cshs module is installed).

evals.prompt: Where do you configure the Menu Link Weight module, and what permission is required (it does not define its own)?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/user-interface/menu-link-weight (route menu_link_weight.settings), gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission. The module defines no permission of its own.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which parent menu link selector widget is Menu Link Weight configured to use? Inspect the live configuration and report the value.
evals.expected_output: It is set to 'cshs': menu_link_weight.settings:menu_parent_form_selector = 'cshs' (drush cget menu_link_weight.settings menu_parent_form_selector). Note the cshs service override only activates if the cshs module is also installed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is Menu Link Weight configured to use the client-side hierarchical select or the default parent menu link selector? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
On this Drupal site, configure Menu Link Weight to use the Client-side hierarchical select ('cshs') parent menu link selector. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: menu_link_weight.settings:menu_parent_form_selector becomes 'cshs' (drush cset menu_link_weight.settings menu_parent_form_selector cshs -y, or via the settings form / config API).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Menu Link Weight is currently set to use the CSHS parent selector. Reconfigure it to use the default parent menu link selector instead, and apply the change to the live site.
